The topic is agreed with the supervisor, an application is filed with the Department Secretariat, and students must enroll in the ‘Diploma Thesis’ course each semester while the thesis is in progress. Semesters officially suspended do not count toward time limits. Completion is confirmed when the supervisor judges that agreed objectives have been met in scope, depth, results, and document quality; formatting, submission, and any presentation/defense requirements are communicated in departmental instructions.
